title: Rendlesham: The Military Memo Behind Britain’s UFO Mystery
description:
In December 1980, US personnel near RAF Woodbridge reported unusual lights in Rendlesham Forest. Lt. Col. Charles Halt later sent a memorandum titled “Unexplained Lights”, dated January 13, 1981. Witness accounts and measurements remain controversial; skeptical explanations include Orford Ness lighthouse and other ordinary sources. The existence of a military report does not establish extraterrestrial origin.

This edit uses the real memorandum and later location photographs. Forest video is illustrative, filmed in Iran, and does not show the reported events. No verified sighting footage is included.

No verified sighting footage was found in the sources searched. No recreation or synthetic UFO is presented as evidence.
